assessment.summary: Checkpoint 184 improves confirmed distance relative to checkpoint 76, but hold success does not improve. Its paired exploration median is close to the older checkpoint 50 and its 1-second hold count remains lower. Historical elite distance 21.89 m is not reproduced by this final-policy evaluation.
limitations: One training seed and one paired evaluation seed; no causal SIL ablation.
Deterministic agents duplicate one exact trajectory; do not interpret them as independent trials.
D is confirmed reference-route progress, not vertical height or game completion.
Terminal projected progress outside the corridor is not confirmed progress.
